evidence_text: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries said dead stingrays found in Seeb were caused by bycatch from fishermen and not by red tide.
Authorities said dead fish on Qurum beach were caused by bycatch and fish slipping from nets rather than a bloom event.
The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries said oxygen shortage from green tide caused dead fish near the port area in Seeb.
The ministry said phytoplankton was active in Muscat waters but no harmful algae or environmental damage had been observed.
The ministry said phytoplankton was active in South Al Sharqiyah waters but no harmful algae or environmental damage had been observed.
Authorities reported green tide conditions and fish mortality affecting the South Al Sharqiyah and Al Wusta coasts, including Masirah waters.
Environment Authority reported dead fish at Ras Al Hadd and said specialists found natural causes rather than red tide.
Red tide outbreaks from South Batinah to Muscat prompted a public health warning; dead fish were reported at beaches including Qurum and Seeb.
